mentions.name: Epilude
mentions.description: Voice dictation and text editing app for Mac that runs completely locally. Built to be fast and offer a good user experience, after the builders found existing dictation options lacking.
mentions.problem: Available dictation options didn't run completely locally, weren't fast, and lacked a good UX.
mentions.source_excerpt: Local voice dictation and text editing for Mac. We'd tried most of the available options but wanted something that runs completely locally, is fast and has a good UX.
mentions.author: oakst
